labels.status: EXECUTED (model runs). Numerics VERIFIED by tests/test_spray_evaporation.py. NOT experimentally VALIDATED.
labels.nominal: Module 09 model as derived, k = 1, NOT tuned to CFD. Known limitation: vs OpenFOAM phase A it evaporates 1.5-2.5x the CFD value at A1 (1 bar, 360 K) and +1 to +12 pp at A2 (20 bar, 700 K).
labels.cfd_matched: SENSITIVITY BOUND, not a validated model: one droplet-gas transfer multiplier per CFD condition fitted to A1-BLEND / A2-BLEND (model-vs-model; the CFD itself is unvalidated and has wall-bounce, no film). Same multiplier applied to ethanol without ethanol CFD.

assumptions.inputs: Module 03 design_point.json (CR, w, T_intake, rpm, trapped air/alcohol/water masses); residual gas neglected in the Module 09 parcel
assumptions.pressure_trace: Module 03 integrate_cycle(keep_trace=True) motored p(theta) with Woschni wall heat and Module 03's own water evaporation schedule, IVC -180 -> spark; imposed in Module 09 'pt' mode (adiabatic Module 09 parcel)
assumptions.spark_timing: CA50 - 0-50 % burn angle from Module 03 Wiebe a=5, m=2 (Module 03 reports no 0-50 % angle)
assumptions.venturi: carb_design.json is NOT committed on wme1-dev (an uncommitted copy exists in Hermes's working tree, not used); Nukiyama-Tanasawa at the 30 m/s SPEC fallback throat speed (FLAGGED)
assumptions.runner: U = 30.0 m/s, L = 0.2 m, D = 0.035 m, plenum T = Module 03 T_intake, 1 bar
assumptions.wall: bend deposition only (Pui et al. 1987); deposited liquid leaves the charge (no film re-evaporation; Module 13)
assumptions.ethanol: CoolProp Ethanol liquid; San Diego mechanism vapour thermo/transport; DECHEMA/ChemSep Wilson (NRTL cross-check)

ethanol_liquid.value: CoolProp Ethanol EOS (Schroeder et al. 2014) saturated liquid incl. CoolProp transport/surface tension

ethanol_vapour.value: San Diego mechanism NASA7 thermo + transport (mechanisms/sandiego.yaml), GRI-Mech 3.0 has no ethanol
ethanol_vapour.caveat: NASA7 low range starts at 300 K; 200-300 K gas values are polynomial extrapolation

activity_model_ethanol.source: DECHEMA (Gmehling et al.) ethanol-water parameters as distributed in the ChemSep interaction-parameter database (Kooijman & Taylor 2008), files wilson.json / nrtl.ipd of the 'thermo' Python package (C. Bell)

liquid_properties.value: CoolProp saturated liquid (water IAPWS-95; methanol de Reuck & Craven 1993)

gas_thermo_transport.value: Cantera GRI-Mech 3.0 NASA polynomials and mixture-averaged transport

activity_model.source: Gmehling et al., Vapor-Liquid Equilibrium Data Collection, DECHEMA Chemistry Data Series vol. I (1977-1988), via Smith, Van Ness & Abbott, Intro. Chem. Eng. Thermodynamics 7th ed., Table 13.10

liquid_mixture_density.rationale: excess volume of methanol-water about -3 %, neglected

blend_sigma_mu_for_SMD.value: ideal mole-fraction sigma, Arrhenius log-mole mu
blend_sigma_mu_for_SMD.caveat: approximation; real blend sigma is lower, so blend SMD is biased high

A1-BLEND.objective: RMS of evaporated % on a 0.1 ms grid

A2-BLEND.objective: RMS of evaporated % on a 0.1 ms grid

cfd_matched_fit.interpolation: k(p): ln-p interpolation between A1 (1 bar) and A2 (20 bar), clamped; k_A1 in runner/induction
